parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。

如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name that you want to query.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。

如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include this token in the next request to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识。如果存在下一页，服务会返回此token，下次请求带上即可
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en:
The dictionary sorting method for querying property data. Valid values:
0: sorts the values of the Identifier response parameter in reverse dictionary order.
1: sorts the values of the Identifier response parameter in dictionary order
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询属性数据的字典排序方式。取值：
0：根据返回参数Identifier的值，按照字典倒序。
1：根据返回参数Identifier的值，按照字典正序
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device that you want to query. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.

IotId is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether a next page of property records exists.

true: A next page exists.
false: No next page exists.

If NextValid is true, you can use the value of NextPageToken as the NextPageToken in the next request to query the data that is not displayed in the current query
NextValid.description_zh:

true：有。
false：没有。

返回NextValid为true时，可以将NextPageToken的值作为下次查询的NextPageToken，继续查询本次查询不显示的数据
